title: ogr-main
description: OGR head-module (I2C master) library: the sketch on top, the bus only through one transport interface

blocks.title: Your sketch
blocks.details:
Sources: `README.md` (Usage), `examples/BasicScan/BasicScan.ino`, `src/OgrMainEsp32.h`

1. `#include <OgrMainEsp32.h>` — engine plus ESP32 transport.
2. Create `OgrEsp32Transport transport(Wire, sda, scl, en)` and `OgrMaster master(transport)`.
3. Register events: `onModuleDiscovered`, `onModuleProblem`, `onModuleRecovered`, `onModuleRemoved`, optional `onDebugTrace`.
4. `master.begin()` in `setup()`, `master.update(millis())` in `loop()`.
5. Read the table with `moduleCount()` / `moduleAt()` and use the register API for endpoints.

`examples/BasicScan` is a complete sketch, built in CI for esp32dev, ESP32-S3 and ESP32-C3.

children.title: Scan cycles
children.details:
Source: `src/OgrMaster.cpp` `update()`, `tickHealthCheck()`, `tickScanForNew()`, `tickFullRangeScan()`

- **Health-check** every 50 ms: one known module per tick (`healthCheckOne()`).
- **Scan-for-new** every 200 ms: probe `0x08`.
- **Full-range** every 30 s, and once right after `begin()`: one address per tick over `0x01–0x77`.
- Each `update()` does at most one bus transaction's worth of work and never blocks for a full sweep.
- Periods and thresholds are tunable via `set*()` before `begin()`.

children.title: Enumeration
children.details:
Source: `src/OgrMaster.cpp` `probeForNewModule()`, `beginRegisterModuleAtDefaultAddress()`, `tickPendingVerification()`, `finishRegisterModule()`, `allocateFreeAddress()`

- A module on `0x08`: read `CLASS`, `EP_COUNT`, `SYS_FLAGS`, write `SET_ADDR`.
- Then a **non-blocking** settle wait (`kSetAddrSettleMs`, 50 ms), then read `PROT_VER` back at the new address before adding the module to the table.
- New addresses come from `0x09–0x77`; `0x01–0x07` are left unused by choice, not by spec.

children.title: Orphan recovery
children.details:
Source: `src/OgrMaster.cpp` `recoverOrphan()` (synchronous)

- An unknown address found by the full-range scan is never adopted in place (spec §3.5).
- Restart known modules from the topmost down until the orphan stops answering; it then re-enumerates in physical order.
- **Empty table fallback** (fresh master reboot): restart the orphan directly. Not spelled out in the spec; flagged in `README.md` as an interpretation to confirm.

children.title: Module table
children.details:
Sources: `src/OgrModule.h`, `src/OgrMaster.cpp` `healthCheckOne()`, `addModuleSlot()`, `removeModuleAt()`

- `ModuleInfo`: address, class, endpoint count, flags, state (`Ok` / `Problem`).
- Up to `OGR_MAX_MODULES` (default 12, the spec's per-chain limit); no dynamic allocation.
- Two separate counters: `addressNackStreak` → removed after K NACKs; `responseFailStreak` (STATUS ≠ 0, exhausted retries) → `Problem` after N.
- UNASSIGNED modules are not in the table yet; REMOVED ones are deleted.

children.title: Register API
children.details:
Source: `src/OgrMaster.cpp` `readRegisterRaw()` and the public `read*` / `write*` methods

- System bytes, `restart()`, `selectEndpoint()`, endpoint descriptor and data, PLANT_UID, blueprint UID.
- Every frame carries a CRC-8/SMBUS PEC (`writePec()`, `readPec()`).
- Reads retry up to 3 times on a PEC mismatch; an address NACK is never retried, it feeds the removal counter.
- Writes report only bus-level delivery; read back or check `STATUS` when a write matters.

children.title: IOgrMasterTransport
children.details:
Source: `src/OgrMasterTransport.h`

- `begin()`, `write(address, payload, len)`, `writeRead(address, …, readBuf, readLen, outLen)`.
- Result: `BusResult::Ok`, `AddressNack`, `DataNack`, `Error`.
- The engine sees only this interface, so its logic runs on the host against a mock.

children.title: OgrEsp32Transport
children.details:
Source: `src/hal/OgrEsp32Transport.h`, `src/hal/OgrEsp32Transport.cpp`

- Constructor: `TwoWire` (`Wire` or `Wire1`), SDA, SCL, EN pin. Nothing is pinned to a board.
- Bus speed fixed at 100 kHz (spec §1).
- **Drives EN high once in `begin()`.** Pass `-1` only if the board really hardwires EN: a floating EN pin measured ~3 V and made discovery intermittent on real hardware.
- Maps `Wire.endTransmission()` codes to `BusResult`.

blocks.title: Constants
blocks.details:
Sources: `src/OgrTypes.h`, `src/OgrCrc8.h`

- `OgrTypes.h` mirrors the spec's register map, `Status`, `RestartType`, flags, `ClassId`, `TypeId`, `Mode`, `Format` (same constants as in `ogr-node-core`, kept as a copy).
- `OgrCrc8.h`: CRC-8/SMBUS for the PEC byte.

blocks.title: Host tests
blocks.details:
Sources: `test/test_master/test_master.cpp`, `test/test_crc8/test_crc8.cpp`, `test/mocks/MockMasterTransport.h`, `platformio.ini`

- `pio test -e native`: the engine runs against a small bus simulator.
- Covered: address assignment and registration order, health-check Ok / Problem (STATUS and comm failures) / Removed, orphan recovery (cascade and empty-table fallback), endpoint data round trip.
- The example is also built for three ESP32 boards with `pio ci` (commands in `README.md`).
